reliability_note: The transferit-py client sets a 10-year MAX_EXPIRY_SECONDS clamp, but this is client-side only: the first-party reverse-engineering note records that the MEGA bt7 server empirically accepts durations up to about 2^32 seconds (~136 years), with spurious -11 at exact powers of two, and that the web UI offers presets of {0, 7, 30, 90, 180, 365} days. A 90-day server clamp is not confirmed by these first-party sources.
